description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartDao interface, providing data access methods for ShoppingCart entities using JPA and QueryDSL. It includes methods for retrieving shopping carts by ID, code, customer, with specific store context, and for removing shopping carts.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ShoppingCartDao for database operations related to ShoppingCart entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID with optional eager fetching of the merchant store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Finds a ShoppingCart by its shopping cart code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID within a specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a given ShoppingCart from the database.
